jobs.title: Research & Development Intern - University Collaboration
jobs.introduction: Developed Python components for a repository-wide agentic test generation framework that transforms software requirements and repository code into executable test scripts.
descriptions: Built agent workflows with Claude Code, OpenAI SDK, and OpenSearch/RAG; evaluated code retrieval, code maps, and token use efficiency.
Built a forward-proxy framework to capture prompts, responses, tool calls, and session-linked agent traces.
Designed and implemented a rule-based and LLM-based trace evaluation framework using Langfuse traces.
Debugged, documented, and resolved failures in tool use, context awareness, instruction following, and output consistency.
Collaborated remotely and on site with Huawei's Beijing engineering and research team.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.introduction: Developed backend services for HEMS, a nationwide examination-management platform.
descriptions: Developed Java/Spring Boot REST APIs and PostgreSQL backend functionality for HEMS.
Translated client requirements into backend and database designs.
Built grading, result-processing, and reporting workflows for approximately 30,000 students annually.
Integrated two payment gateways handling approximately BDT 4 million in annual transactions.
Implemented mobile-client REST APIs with JWT authentication.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (External)
jobs.introduction: Worked remotely on an external assignment through DSi with Synopsys Inc., contributing to Black Duck Detect, a software composition analysis tool that identifies dependency-related component, security, and license risks.
descriptions: Contributed Java, Groovy, and Gradle changes to Black Duck Detect.
Migrated the Detect project CI/CD pipeline from Jenkins to GitHub Actions.
Diagnosed and fixed two defects affecting scheduled jobs and artifact versioning.
Migrated analytics from Google Universal Analytics to GA4, restoring a broken reporting dashboard.

researchProjects.title: SecVulEval - Context-Aware C/C++ Vulnerability Benchmark
researchProjects.introduction: Built a real-world C/C++ vulnerability benchmark with 25,440 functions covering 5,867 CVEs.
descriptions: Curated paired vulnerable/fixed code with statement-level vulnerability labels and external program context.
Designed and implemented a multi-stage LLM-agent pipeline for context-aware vulnerability detection.
Evaluated five LLMs at function and statement levels, with ablations and failure analysis.
Received the Best Dataset & Benchmark Paper award at AIware 2026. 🏆
Made the dataset publicly available at HuggingFace - SecVulEval for community use.

researchProjects.title: StaAgent - An Agentic Framework for Testing Static Analyzers
researchProjects.introduction: Developed an LLM-assisted, mutation-based metamorphic-testing framework for static-analysis rule implementations.
descriptions: My highlighted work uncovered 42 faulty rule implementations across SpotBugs, Error Prone, and PMD.
Findings were reported to developers; some issues were already fixed. Status is available in the linked preprint.
Accepted as an article in ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM) 2026.
